text:
GENERATE BURST K2p-gen-E-r2 — Keeper H1 rest frame, direction E — the base for walk-E (HITL Run C-2 step 7a; the K2 turnaround is superseded in pixels by R-23). task_id "K2p-gen-E-r2".

Image 1 is the APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER (direction S, facing the camera). Deliver EXACTLY ONE image: the SAME character — same face, hair mass, skin, costume, every item and its side, same proportions, same standing rest pose (weight even, arms relaxed, the plain walnut staff upright in the RIGHT hand) — with the CHARACTER ROTATED to face E, defined as: the character is in full RIGHT-facing profile — it faces screen-right; only its left side is visible; the satchel on the left hip is toward the camera The satchel (left hip) is toward the camera, in front of the body; the staff hand is on the far side, partly hidden behind the body, the staff tip still rising above the shoulder.. Image 2 is a GEOMETRY-ONLY reference: the same character type in this exact E view, drawn earlier in a different register — copy from it ONLY the body geometry and equipment placement: the full right-facing profile, the harness strap EMERGING FROM BEHIND THE NECK (from the far right shoulder) and running down the FRONT of the chest, the bare near shoulder, the staff in the far right hand held upright in front of the body. Do NOT copy Image 2's face, hair, proportions, brushwork or painted register — identity and register come from Image 1 and this text. Image 2 OMITS the satchel; the output must NOT: the olive canvas satchel hangs from the bottom end of the strap at her near LEFT hip, toward the camera, in front of the near thigh, its brass corners visible. STRAP GEOMETRY IN THIS VIEW (the previous attempt got it wrong — read carefully): the harness is ONE strap that goes over her RIGHT shoulder and down across the FRONT of her chest to her LEFT hip. In this right-facing profile her RIGHT shoulder is the FAR shoulder, hidden behind her neck — so the strap EMERGES FROM BEHIND HER NECK at the top of the torso and runs diagonally down the FRONT of her chest (toward screen-right) to the satchel on her near LEFT hip. Her visible NEAR (left) shoulder is BARE: NO strap passes over the visible shoulder. The satchel hangs at her near left hip, toward the camera. Her near LEFT arm hangs relaxed at her side with its laced bracer; her far RIGHT arm holds the plain walnut staff upright in front of her body, the hand at chest height, the staff's foot on the ground beside her far boot and its tip above her head. Full profile: her chest faces screen-right, her nose and boot toes point screen-right. The camera is fixed for every direction: an elevated three-quarter pinhole view from the front, ~53° above the ground plane (projection C); the character turns, the camera does not. The light is fixed for every direction: a single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT that does NOT rotate with the character — the key-facing side is the screen-left side in every direction; deep cool ambient; readable shadows, never pure black; slight rim on the key-facing edge; no spell glow; NO floor shadow. NO MIRRORING: this is the character turned, never a flipped image — the staff stays in the anatomical right hand, the satchel on the anatomical left hip, the harness strap over the right shoulder, whichever side those land on screen. Same framing and standing height as Image 1: full body, feet fully visible, centred, on a flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; portrait canvas like Image 1; do not matte. Identity for reference, unchanged: a YOUNG WOMAN, early 20s, dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned, face visible, no helmet; ivory linen shirt, navy sleeveless tabard with a PLAIN chest (no emblem of any kind), ONE chestnut diagonal harness strap carrying an olive canvas satchel on the figure's LEFT hip, ONE waist belt, chestnut laced bracers, navy trousers, chestnut buckled boots; a PLAIN dark walnut staff with small brass ferrules at foot and tip (NO ring, NO head-piece) in the RIGHT hand; NO insignia anywhere — every surface plain. Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside the line, restrained texture; the line carries the pose. It should look like one frame of hand-drawn animation, not a rendered illustration.

One image_gen call; ONE retry only if the result is off-plate, has a baked checkerboard, is mirrored (rod in the wrong hand) or invents extra objects — name the retry reason in the receipt. Copy the final output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/k2p_E_r2.png and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K2p-gen-E-r2"): images = the one file with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls (1 or 2); status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.

GEOMETRY-ONLY reference for the E view (strap from behind the neck across the chest front; bare near shoulder; staff in the far hand) — do NOT copy its face, register or brushwork; it omits the satchel, the output must not
